title: ir.routing.requested
description: Decision D-interface (Trust Architecture §3.2): the ReasoningRequest contract. Deliberately has NO model, governance_tier, privacy_class, or actor field -- a field that does not exist cannot be under-declared (FR-IRG-FND-05). Caller identity comes from the workload certificate at the transport layer, never from this payload.

reasoning_class.description: Must be a class registered in ir_reasoning_classes (FR-IRG-FND-01); never a concrete model id (FR-IRG-FND-04).

task_ref.description: Workflow/run id. Router-side task taint (FR-IRG-INT-02) accumulates here; the agent cannot edit this record.

input.description: Content, or immutable mesh event references -- never a raw payload duplicated into router stores (FR-IRG-STT-03).

hints.description: Tighten-only hints. A hint may raise the effective governance/privacy floor; it can never lower it (decision: declared vs derived, Trust Architecture §1).

override.description: Present only for the admin source in the MVP (FR-IRG-FND-04); template arrives with the Adaptive track (decision R5). Absent for ordinary agent calls.
